fields.name: amount
fields.short: Numeric Transaction Amount.

fields.name: authorization_number
fields.short: For Gratuity (msg type 0009): the authorization number of the original transaction.

fields.name: card_number
fields.short: Depends on the transaction scenario: - **Standard Pin Pad transaction:** leave empty.

fields.name: currency
fields.short: ISO 4217 Alpha Currency Code (e.g., "EUR", "USD").

fields.name: cvc2
fields.short: Card Verification Code.

fields.name: desired_currency
fields.short: ISO 4217 Alpha Currency Code in which the transaction will be processed (e.g., "EUR", "USD").

fields.name: ecr_data
fields.short: ECR Data field used to transfer user information for private-labeled cards (e.g., Fleet Card Company such as UTA, outex).

fields.name: language
fields.short: ISO 639-1 language code used by the Pin Pad user interface during the transaction (e.g., "en", "de", "es").

fields.name: message_type
fields.short: Message type code.

fields.name: password
fields.short: Password - currently not used (filled with spaces).

fields.name: payment_reason
fields.short: Payment reason (e.g., "Taxi journey").

fields.name: payment_reasonAsByte
fields.short: Payment reason represented as a byte array.

fields.name: personal_id
fields.short: Identification of the current user of the ECR or Terminal.

fields.name: receipt_layout
fields.short: Receipt layout identifier.

fields.name: receipt_number
fields.short: Receipt number.

fields.name: terminal_number
fields.short: Terminal number provided by TECS.

fields.name: transaction_date_time
fields.short: Transaction date and time (format: yyyymmddhhmmss).

fields.name: transaction_id
fields.short: Unique transaction identifier.

fields.name: transaction_origin_identifier
fields.short: Transaction origin identifier: - 1 = Face to Face (Customer present) - 2 = MOTO (Customer not present) - 4 = Capture/Completion - 5 = Pre Authorization - 7 = Balance

fields.name: transaction_origin_indicator
fields.short: Transaction origin indicator: - 0 = Request for card data on PIN PAD.

fields.name: transaction_place
fields.short: The transaction place; the first 5 characters should contain a formatted zip code.

fields.name: transaction_source_id
fields.short: Identification number of the authorization source.
